ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Neptune

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between family and your image. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between money and friendships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your image and your career. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your career and relationships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between relationships and family. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between routine and conversations. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between romance and money. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.
